# `ContentRegistry::cells`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-content">content</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **Content** (`src/plugins/content.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns every registered cell descriptor by stable content id.

## Signature

```rust
fn cells (& self) -> & BTreeMap < ContentId , CellContentDescriptor >
```

## Arguments

This method does not take plugin-supplied arguments.

## Return Value

& BTreeMap < [`ContentId`](../structures/contentid.md) , [`CellContentDescriptor`](../structures/cellcontentdescriptor.md) >
